Theme

Tools, fasteners & household repair

pipe noun

plumbing

also water pipe, tube

classical

Varro, LL 5.123: fistula, ā quā fūsus aquae
Traupman 404

fistula, fistulae f.

noun, first declension

pipe or tube

These are the construction and plumbing senses; English “pipe” as a smoking implement or musical instrument needs its own context.

Other words

  • fistula aquāria; fistulae aquāriae f. — water pipe

    also used · modern · M-O s.v. pipe (plumbing); Traupman 124, 404

  • tubulus, tubulī m. — small pipe or tube

    noun, second declension · also used · classical

    Morgan–Owens also records it for plumbing.

Examples

  • Fistulam aquāriam affer.

    Bring the water pipe.composed

  • Aqua per fistulam fluit.

    Water flows through the pipe.composed

  • fistulīs plumbeīs seu tubulīs fictilibus

    lead pipes or clay tubesVitr. 8.6.1

SourcesMorgan–Owens: pipe (plumbing) · Lewis & Short: fistula · Lewis & Short: tubulus · Traupman: Conversational Latin, fourth edition
